Brandon Herrera

Republican candidate for U.S. Representative, District 23, Bexar County, Texas · Open seat

Firearms manufacturer and YouTube content creator

Brandon Herrera is a firearms manufacturer and YouTube personality known online as "The AK Guy." He advanced to a runoff with incumbent Rep. Tony Gonzales in the March 3, 2026 Republican primary for Texas' 23rd Congressional District. Gonzales later ended his re-election campaign and resigned, and Herrera is the Republican nominee on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot against Katy Padilla Stout (D) and Ben Mendoza (I).

Where Herrera stands

Border security
Pledges to oppose any spending bill that does not fund completion of the border wall, and supports reinstating the "Remain in Mexico" policy and ending what he calls abuse of the asylum system.
Border wall in Big Bend
Opposes border wall construction in the Big Bend region. His campaign calls a physical wall there unnecessary because of the area's rugged terrain, and he welcomed a pause on construction there.
Taxes, spending and regulation
Pledges no new taxes, says he will cut wasteful spending, and supports the REINS Act.
Second Amendment
Supports national concealed carry reciprocity and says he wants to expand gun rights.
School safety
When asked about the Uvalde shooting in a debate, he asked why the state did not have armed security at schools to protect children.
Data centers
Said in a debate that West Texas has become "ground zero" for data centers in the country.
Veterans
Proposes better access to services and support for veterans and their families.

Background

  • Occupation: founder of a firearms manufacturing business
  • Host of a firearms-focused YouTube channel ("The AK Guy")
  • Education: studied pre-law at Campbell College; left before finishing to start his business
  • 2026: advanced to a runoff in the Republican primary for TX-23 (March 3, 2026); now the Republican nominee
  • Has not held elected office
